content.text: Let me check the data to understand what constitutes "statutory share reimbursed by Health Insurance" and examine the date format:

input.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT FLX_ANN_MOI, SOI_ANN, SOI_MOI 
FROM ANALYTICS.MARTS.FCT_REIMBURSEMENTS 
WHERE FLX_ANN_MOI >= 202503 AND FLX_ANN_MOI <= 202503
LIMIT 10

content.text: Now let me check the region data and look at the reimbursement columns to find the "statutory share reimbursed by Health Insurance":

input.sql:
SELECT dr.BEN_RES_REG, dr.BEN_RES_REG_LIB, 
       SUM(fr.PRS_REM_MNT) as statutory_reimbursement
FROM ANALYTICS.MARTS.FCT_REIMBURSEMENTS fr
JOIN ANALYTICS.MARTS.DIM_REGION dr ON fr.ETP_REG_COD = dr.BEN_RES_REG
WHERE fr.FLX_ANN_MOI = 202503
GROUP BY dr.BEN_RES_REG, dr.BEN_RES_REG_LIB
ORDER BY statutory_reimbursement DESC
LIMIT 10

content.text: Perfect! I can see that region 99 is "Inconnu" (Unknown). The question asks to leave out the unknown region. Now I'll get the top 3 regions excluding the unknown one, ordered by highest amount first:

input.sql:
SELECT dr.BEN_RES_REG_LIB as region_name, 
       SUM(fr.PRS_REM_MNT) as statutory_reimbursement
FROM ANALYTICS.MARTS.FCT_REIMBURSEMENTS fr
JOIN ANALYTICS.MARTS.DIM_REGION dr ON fr.ETP_REG_COD = dr.BEN_RES_REG
WHERE fr.FLX_ANN_MOI = 202503
  AND dr.BEN_RES_REG != 99
GROUP BY dr.BEN_RES_REG_LIB
ORDER BY statutory_reimbursement DESC
LIMIT 3

content.text: Perfect! I have found the three regions with the highest statutory share reimbursed by Health Insurance in March 2025, excluding the unknown region.

input.final_sql:
SELECT dr.BEN_RES_REG_LIB as region_name, 
       SUM(fr.PRS_REM_MNT) as amount
FROM ANALYTICS.MARTS.FCT_REIMBURSEMENTS fr
JOIN ANALYTICS.MARTS.DIM_REGION dr ON fr.ETP_REG_COD = dr.BEN_RES_REG
WHERE fr.FLX_ANN_MOI = 202503
  AND dr.BEN_RES_REG != 99
GROUP BY dr.BEN_RES_REG_LIB
ORDER BY amount DESC
LIMIT 3
